overall_assessment: Section extraction works very well for NMBU: all eight courses have correct, complete sections, CSS/metadata junk is excluded, and obligatory activities are correctly routed to coursework_requirements. Both pre-pass flags are false alarms (a short but real prerequisite 'PPXP100'; a 'leak->reading_list' hit on ordinary teaching text). Only minor issues remain.

findings.description: The 'Læringsstøtte' block (supervision and learning support, e.g. 40 hours of guidance in the M30 course) is present in the plan but appears in no extracted section. It is arguably part of teaching_methods; the loss is silent.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No heading pattern for 'Læringsstøtte' in R/section_heading_map.R, so the block is dropped.
findings.suggested_fix: Map '^Læringsstøtte' to teaching_methods in R/section_heading_map.R, or confirm against section_codebook.yml that it is intentionally ignored.

findings.description: Sub-headings (Kunnskap / Ferdigheter / Generell kompetanse) are stripped inconsistently: most are removed leaving bare 'Kandidaten'/'Studenten' lines, while 'Generelle ferdigheter' survives in PPUT301. All content is retained, so nothing is lost, but the group labels are mostly gone and the result is inconsistent.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Sub-heading handling in R/extract_sections.R (.clean_sections) matches only some label variants.
findings.suggested_fix: Either keep the Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse labels consistently, or extend the strip pattern to cover 'Generelle ferdigheter' and similar variants.
